note: Enigma I, M3 and M4 with the historical rotors, reflectors and plugboard; one reciprocal word (alias decrypt).

Real Typex rotor wirings were never published, so there is no built-in rotor set: the five rotor wirings, reflector, notches and reversed rotors are parameters (validated permutations of A-Z), with clearly labelled non-historical example defaults. The conventions (rotors written left to right with the signal entering at the right, notch letters tested after the step, reversed rotors as neg o inverse o neg, the entry plugboard as a 26-letter wiring entering c as -P(c), Enigma-style stepping with the double step) follow CyberChef's for compatibility; the real Typex conventions are unpublished.
